TUD is part of the European university alliance EUTOPIA. Together with nine other partner universities, we are shaping teaching and research across borders – open, connected, and future-oriented. EUTOPIA brings together people, ideas, and perspectives within a strong European higher education area.

The TUD Dresden University of Technology (TUD) is a strong partner for cooperation in research, teaching and transfer - locally, nationally and internationally. As a founding member of the DRESDEN-concept (DDc) research alliance, it forms the DDc Science and Innovation Campus together with over 40 non-university research and cultural institutions. This is a unique place for interdisciplinary collaboration and scientific excellence in Dresden and the region.

TUD Dresden University of Technology is one of the leading technical universities in Germany and attaches great importance to excellent collaborations. In the recently established “Startup Campus Alliance,” TU Dresden is working with nine partner universities from Saxony and Thuringia to foster entrepreneurship and a sustainable start-up culture. As Germany’s leading university in patent activity, TU Dresden contributes its transfer structures and expertise to the new alliance through TUD|excite. Together, the partners aim to position Central Germany as a leading deep-tech region.

In 2023, TU Dresden opened its first Liaison Office abroad in Taipei, Taiwan. Our collaboration with Taiwanese partners, such as the National Taiwan University and TSMC, focuses on microelectronics and semiconductor technology. For example, the STIPT program offers students from all over Saxony a unique opportunity to gain qualifications in this high-tech sector.
